description: Vertical event markers for the equity curve / dashboard charts. Edit this file to add/remove markers; publish_artifacts will copy the list into dashboard.json on the next pipeline run. Frontend renders them as vertical lines or labels on time-series charts.

markers.label: First live trade
markers.description: Bot exits cash-only posture; first 5 fills (VLUE, XLB, VEA, SCHD).

markers.label: vol_uncertainty re-armed
markers.description: F-1 self-healed: VIX-driven vol_uncertainty exits the 0.10 floor (where it was held for 168 days) and starts producing real percentile values. Coincides with start of SPY-relative lag.

markers.label: Hybrid live (params)
markers.description: Decision-params bundle updated to hybrid ranking blend 0.35 (commit c4e8831). New buy basket entered Apr 6-8.

markers.label: Phase-4 bug fixes shipped
markers.description: F-1/3/6/8/9 vol_uncertainty degraded surfacing, F-4/5 unified cost basis, F-7 fragility-relax knob (default off), F-6 per-signal status flags. Branch ai/diagnostic-fix-batch.

markers.label: Optimized champion promoted
markers.description: Optimized champion line (extend_relax_choppy + topup_psm) promoted as the dashboard's canonical line, with the previous champion shown as a dashed comparison. portfolio_value invariant (cash + sum(shares × close)) verified.

markers.label: Regime model retrained (forward)
markers.description: Regime ensemble retrained on 11yr corpus (out-of-sample accuracy 9%% -> 73%%, replacing models trained on ~11 rows). Applies to decisions from this date FORWARD; prior history is unchanged (continuity preserved). Also: champion config tuned (position weight 0.20->0.30, topup 1.2->1.1) lifting the line from +12.5%% to +15.0%% whole-period.
